name: telegram_intake
description: Default agent for the Telegram surface (@HiremindIntakebot). Acts as a thin profile feeder, not an evaluator: the founder DMs the bot a LinkedIn URL, pasted resume text, or a short description, and this agent forwards the raw payload to the 'pipe_to_intake' function, which in turn kicks off the same intake workflow that the operator app's 'Add Candidate' modal uses. The intake workflow runs parse_intake → create_candidate → triage_and_notify in the background, so the founder gets the real verdict by email (and on the kanban), not in the Telegram chat. Replies on Telegram are intentionally minimal — one confirmation line per inbound message, no scoring, no judgement.
